query_text: Recommend high-quality cookware brands for serious home cooks. Name several specific brands.
response_text:
# Top Cookware Brands for Serious Home Cooks

## Premium Tier
- **All-Clad** - Industry gold standard for stainless steel; exceptional heat distribution and durability
- **Le Creuset** - Iconic French enameled cast iron; lifetime investment pieces
- **Staub** - Superior enameled cast iron with self-basting lids; preferred by many chefs
- **Mauviel** - French copper cookware; unmatched heat responsiveness

## High-Quality Mid-Range
- **Zwilling/Demeyere** - Belgian-made stainless steel with excellent engineering
- **Lodge** - Best value cast iron; American-made and pre-seasoned
- **Cuisinart MultiClad Pro** - Solid tri-ply construction at accessible prices
- **Tramontina Tri-Ply Clad** - Excellent All-Clad alternative for budget-conscious buyers

## Specialty Standouts
- **Matfer Bourgeat** - Professional-grade carbon steel (especially frying pans)
- **Victoria** - High-quality cast iron at competitive prices
- **Made In** - Direct-to-consumer brand with restaurant-quality construction

## What to Prioritize
Focus on **fully-clad stainless steel** (not just disc bottom) for even heating, and consider starting with a few key pieces from premium brands rather than complete sets from lesser manufacturers.
